desc:
Etsy customer messages and custom requests deserve quick, friendly answers in your own voice. Ecom Swift LLC reads your shop inbox, replies to buyers, handles custom order quotes and builds saved replies, so no message sits unanswered.

## What is Etsy customer message handling?

Etsy customer message handling is the daily work of answering buyers inside Etsy conversations: product questions, shipping updates, custom order requests and complaints. Done well, each reply sounds like you and moves the buyer closer to an order or a happy delivery.

Ecom Swift LLC does this inside your shop. We learn your tone from your past replies, write in it, and keep every conversation on Etsy, where the platform expects it.

## Why unanswered messages cost you orders

A buyer who writes to a shop is usually close to buying. They want to know if a ring comes in another size, whether a print can arrive before a birthday, or if a name can be added. If the answer takes days, they open another tab and buy from a seller who replied first.

Messages also shape how a shop is judged after the sale. A calm, clear answer to a delivery worry often keeps a review positive. A late or curt reply can turn a small problem into a case. Handling messages is part of your shop quality, not an extra chore.

## How good replies lift conversions and repeat orders

A reply works in three ways. It removes the doubt that stopped the buyer, it shows a real person stands behind the item, and it gives a clear next step such as a link to the listing or a request for details. Custom order requests add a fourth: a well-written quote that states what is included, what you need from the buyer and when it will ship tends to convert far better than a vague "yes, I can do that".

Saved replies keep the quality steady. When the five or ten most common questions have a good answer ready, each message takes seconds and nothing is forgotten, even in a busy week.

## What a good message routine includes

- A tone guide taken from your own past replies, so buyers hear the same voice.
- Answers to open product, size, material and shipping questions.
- Saved replies for repeat questions such as processing time, returns and gift notes.
- A clear way to handle custom order requests, from first question to quote.
- Polite wording for delays, damaged items and not-received messages.
- Notes on which messages need your decision, such as refunds and open cases.
- A message log so you can see what was said and to whom.
- Draft replies to feedback and reviews in higher packages.
- A hand-off guide so a helper can continue the same routine.

## What we do

We read your recent conversations and your listings, then write a short tone guide that you approve. Next we answer the open messages in your shop and write saved replies for the questions you get most. For custom requests, we collect the details, check them against what you offer and send a quote you have approved.

Anything about refunds, open cases or money is passed to you first, and we do not decide it for you. The Basic package covers a first batch and a reply set. Standard adds custom order quotes and a larger batch, and Premium adds review reply drafts and a guide for a future helper.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Reply within a day when you can, and say when a longer answer is coming.
- Use the buyer's name and answer the exact question asked.
- State prices, timing and what is included in every quote.
- Keep the whole conversation inside Etsy messages.
- Thank buyers for their patience when a parcel is late.

**Avoid:**
- Pasting the same long reply to every question.
- Taking buyers to email or another app to pay.
- Arguing with an unfair message, which rarely helps.
- Promising a delivery date you cannot control.
- Ignoring a quiet buyer who asked a question days ago.

## Who this service is for

It fits a maker who spends evenings answering messages instead of making products. It helps a seller preparing for a holiday rush who expects the inbox to fill up, and a shop that offers personalized items and needs a steady way to turn custom requests into clear quotes.

## What we need from you

Send a few examples of replies you are proud of, your shipping and returns rules, and a short list of what you can and cannot customize. We work as a shop manager with limited permissions where Etsy supports it, or alongside you on a shared screen. Passwords are never needed. You tell us which topics to pass back to you, and we confirm the plan before we send the first reply.
